This project is a modern blood donation website called 'Blood Link'.
- Use a blood-themed UI and graphics.
- Pages: homepage, login, registration, navigation, donor details, emergency case.
- Use React + TypeScript (Vite) for frontend.
- Backend and database will be added later.
- Focus on clean, accessible, and visually engaging design.
